summary:
For our project of this challenge we have built a space app that can display the movement of certain objects in certain patches of the sky over time, helping users to identify irrationally moving objects and report them for review. After verification, these objects will be added to a flagged list, which can then be used for studying these objects later on, helping us discover new objects in the sky.

Using the Aladin Lite API for our base map and using the sorted data provided, we can select to investigate random patches of the sky to display a path of movement for certain objects. Using these movements user can mark the object with a pointer and submit for review in the 2nd tab of the app.
details:
different users who stumble upon that marked object can see its movement and either approve or disapprove of the report. Once approved, the newly found moving object will be added to the 3rd tab as part of the list of found objects. This list will also include the RA & Declination of the objects, which can then be used for further study of these objects.

Giving us an open-source and interactive user experience where users can directly assist in the finding of brand new objects in the universe, furthering our knowledge as a collective species.
